units.source_text: 不想出口，却断断续续地泄露字句，夕雾便在心中组成诗篇，低声诵念。

en.t: She had not meant to say it aloud, but fragments of words slipped out one after another, and Yugiri formed them into a poem in his mind and softly recited it.

units.source_text: 公主深以为耻，痛悔不该吟出此诗。

en.t: The princess was deeply ashamed and bitterly regretted having recited the poem.

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“我刚才言语不谨，冒犯你了。”

en.t: Yugiri said, "I spoke carelessly just now and offended you."
Then, smiling, he answered with this poem:
